 WWE Crown Jewel streams Saturday, Nov. 7 exclusively on the ESPN App with ESPN Unlimited plan
 Press Release
 November 4, 2026
 Author
 Ronce Rajan 
 Contact(s)
 Ben Cafardo
 ben.cafardo@espn.com 
 Ronce Rajan
 ronce.rajan@espn.com 
 Copy Text to Clipboard Summary
 Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn collide for the Men’s Crown Jewel Championship 
 Liv Morgan faces Chelsea Green for the Women’s Crown Jewel Championship 
 Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton meet in a Last Man Standing Match 
 WWE Crown Jewel will stream in the U.S. exclusively on the ESPN App on Saturday, Nov. 7, at 12 p.m. ET. The Premium Live Event is available to fans with an ESPN Unlimited plan, either directly or through a traditional pay TV package.
 Headlining WWE Crown Jewel , Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn square off for the Men’s Crown Jewel Championship in a champion vs. champion showdown. On the women’s side, Liv Morgan and Chelsea Green battle for the Women’s Crown Jewel Championship. The event will also feature Cody Rhodes taking on Randy Orton in a Last Man Standing Match, while Bron Breakker and Austin Theory of The Vision defend the World Tag Team titles against Penta and Je’Von Evans.
 Coverage on the ESPN App will also include Countdown to Crown Jewel from 10 a.m.-12 p.m. and the post-event show immediately following the conclusion of the Premium Live Event.
 How to Watch WWE Crown Jewel 
 ESPN Studio Coverage 
ESPN will deliver comprehensive, multi-platform coverage of WWE Crown Jewel in the days leading up to the event. WWE Superstars and personalities will appear across ESPN programming, including Unsportsmanlike , Get Up , First Take , SportsCenter and Ahora o Nunca . Scheduled appearances include The Miz, Penta, Peter Rosenberg and Corey Graves, among others, leading into WWE Crown Jewel .
 ESPN will also debut the WWE Crown Jewel Special on Thursday at 11:30 p.m. on ESPN2. The preview show will spotlight key matches and storylines leading into WWE Crown Jewel .
 ESPN Social 
ESPN Social will deliver comprehensive coverage of WWE Crown Jewel across platforms in the lead-up to the Premium Live Event, highlighted by real-time storytelling, original content and fan-first programming designed to drive awareness and tune-in.
 Coverage will include original digital features spotlighting Randy Orton ahead of his Last Man Standing Match against Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns before his champion-vs.-champion showdown with Sami Zayn. ESPN Social will also produce storytelling content exploring the history and rivalry between Reigns and Zayn, while collaborating with ESPN editorial to highlight the legacy of champion-vs.-champion matches and the significance of the Crown Jewel Championship.
 Throughout the week, coverage will feature event-focused programming and call-to-action content directing fans to watch WWE Crown Jewel on the ESPN App. On Saturday, ESPN Social will provide real-time coverage of the Premium Live Event across ESPN social platforms.
 ESPN.com 
ESPN.com will provide comprehensive editorial coverage of WWE Crown Jewel , featuring previews, historical perspective, predictions, live coverage and post-event analysis.
 Coverage includes “Champ vs. Champ: The Top WWE Battles Between Champions,” in which Sean Coyle and Juliana Daddio look back at some of the most memorable champion-vs.-champion matches in WWE history ahead of the Crown Jewel Championship matches, as well as key stats and notes for every match on the Crown Jewel card from Sean Coyle .
 Greg Wyshynski will break down the matches and storylines fans need to know heading into Crown Jewel , while ESPN’s WWE experts will offer predictions and bold picks in a Crown Jewel roundtable discussion.
 On Saturday, Sach Chandan will provide live results and analysis throughout WWE Crown Jewel , followed by a takeaways story examining the event’s biggest moments and what they mean heading into Survivor Series: WarGames .

 ESPN offers its full suite of networks and services directly to fans on the ESPN App with an ESPN Unlimited plan, providing more choice, flexibility and access to all of ESPN, including more than 47,000 live events per year, on-demand replays, industry-leading studio shows and original programming, and more. The ESPN App gives fans a unique viewing experience that includes multiview and synchronized two-screen viewing options, swipe-able shortform vertical video and a personalized SportsCenter For You , as well as integrated game stats, ESPN Fantasy sports, betting odds and information from DraftKings, sports merchandise and more. These features are available to all fans who watch on the ESPN App on mobile and connected TV devices, whether they subscribe directly or through a pay TV package from certain providers. Bundling options available for fans include a Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN offering that provides a one-of-a-kind streaming package combining sports with branded and general entertainment. For more, visit stream.espn.com.
